data.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
“Command the Israelites and say to them, ‘Be careful to present to me at its appointed time my offering, my food for my offerings by fire, a pleasing aroma to me.’
You shall say to them, ‘This is the offering by fire that you shall present to the LORD: two lambs a year old without blemish each day as a regular burnt offering.
You shall offer one lamb in the morning and the second lamb at twilight,
with a grain offering of about two quarts of fine flour mixed with about one quart of oil from beaten olives.
It is the regular burnt offering instituted at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD.
Its drink offering shall be about one quart for each lamb. In the holy place you shall pour out a drink offering of fermented drink to the LORD.
You shall offer the second lamb at twilight. You shall offer it with the same grain offering and drink offering as in the morning, an offering by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
On the Sabbath day, two lambs a year old without blemish, with a grain offering of about four quarts of fine flour mixed with oil, and its drink offering.
This is the burnt offering for each Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
At the beginning of your months you shall present a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs a year old without blemish,
data.titulo: Offerings at the Beginning of Each Month

data.text: with a grain offering of about six quarts of fine flour mixed with oil for each bull, and a grain offering of about four quarts of fine flour mixed with oil for the ram,
and a grain offering of about two quarts of fine flour mixed with oil for each lamb, as a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering by fire to the LORD.

Their drink offerings of wine shall be about two quarts for a bull, about a third of a gallon for a ram, and about one quart for a lamb. This is the burnt offering for each month throughout the months of the year.
One male goat shall be offered as a sin offering to the LORD, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD’s Passover.
data.titulo: Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread

data.text: On the fifteenth day of this month is a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
On the first day there shall be a holy assembly. You shall do no ordinary work.
You shall present an offering by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs a year old. They shall be without blemish.
Their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer about six quarts for a bull and about four quarts for a ram.
You shall offer about two quarts for each lamb, for each of the seven lambs,
and one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
You shall offer these in addition to the morning burnt offering, which is part of the regular burnt offering.
In this way you shall offer each day for seven days food as an offering by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD. It shall be offered in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
On the seventh day you shall have a holy assembly. You shall do no ordinary work.
On the day of firstfruits, when you present a new grain offering to the LORD at your Feast of Weeks, you shall have a holy assembly. You shall do no ordinary work.
data.titulo: Firstfruits at the Feast of Weeks

data.text: You shall present a burnt offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs a year old,
with their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, about six quarts for each bull and about four quarts for the ram,
about two quarts for each lamb, for each of the seven lambs,
and one male goat to make atonement for you.
You shall offer these in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. They shall be without blemish, with their drink offerings.
